Package com.example.goboard.model

Class ScoreCalculator

java.lang.Object
com.example.goboard.model.ScoreCalculator
public class ScoreCalculator extends Object
Calculates scores and territory for Japanese Go rules. Responsibilities: - Count territory based on empty regions - Count prisoners (captured stones + marked dead stones) - Calculate final scores with komi

      public int countPrisoners(Stone.Color color, int blackPrisoners, int whitePrisoners)
      Count prisoners for a color. Includes: captured stones during game + marked dead stones of opponent.
      Parameters:
      color - the color to count prisoners for
      blackPrisoners - captured white stones (for black)
      whitePrisoners - captured black stones (for white)
      Returns:
      total prisoner count

    • countTerritory

      public int countTerritory(Stone.Color color)
      Territory counting based on empty-point groups. Empty intersections are treated like stones of a third color. They form groups and have liberties. If all liberties of an empty group belong to exactly one color, the entire group is territory of that color. If liberties belong to both colors, the group is neutral. Note: Seki regions are excluded from territory.
      Parameters:
      color - the color to count territory for
      Returns:
      territory count

    • calculateScore

      public double calculateScore(Stone.Color color, int blackPrisoners, int whitePrisoners)
      Calculate final score for a color, including komi. For white: territory - black_prisoners + komi For black: territory - white_prisoners
      Parameters:
      color - the color to calculate score for
      blackPrisoners - captured white stones
      whitePrisoners - captured black stones
      Returns:
      final score
